title: Fantastic bike tour
text: Exceptional knowledgeable guide. Easy bikes. Easy to book. Great value for money. I would suggest you look no further and get this booked!
author: Caroline_H

title: Nice bike ride with a top guide!
text:
Last Sunday we did a three-hour e-bike tour. Upon arrival we were immediately received very friendly and we got our bikes. These were also very good and ideal that there was a bicycle basket to put your bag and bottles of water in.
Our guide of the day was Claire. She knew how to convey everything very nicely and knew a lot about the city. We learned a lot about history. Also the interaction with everyone was very nice. Compliments to her, she is a real winner!! 
Barcelona is a fantastic city for cycling, there are good bike paths all over the city. If we go back again we will definitely book
author: Marona V

title: Fun and super interesting bike tour
text: We had a great bike tour visiting lots of beautiful spots in Barcelona with interesting and engaging info from our fabulous guide Enrique. My son George and I thoroughly enjoyed it and would highly recommend this tour as a great intro to the city ❤️
author: JulieBrightonian

title: Great Guided Tour of Barcelona
text: Our guide, Safan was excellent. He was patient, informative, and great company. The 3 hours flew by and we saw a lot of Barcelona. I would highly recommend this excursion that would like to see a lot of Barcelona in a short period of time. It is ideal for cruise passengers.
author: Neil_S

title: Great tour
text:
Cecila was a great guide.  Very kmonoledgeable (or made up good stories)
We rented ebike.  But they were not necessary for this trail.
author: Mark_H

title: Just do it
text: This is a great way to see the city. The ride is mostly flat and the guide navigated all the changing bike lanes with ease.
author: Patti_J

title: Best experience
text: Well organised. Friendly. Informative. Knowledgeable. Start your stay in Barcelona with this tour. Strongly recommend it.
author: Almare_v

title: Lovely morning tour
text: We had a fab time riding around the streets of BCL. Our guide was super. She gave us a choice of tours and was excellent - looked after us all!!
author: louisew297

title: A bicycle is an amazing...
text:
A bicycle is an amazing way to see Barcelona, a city so friendly to bikes. 
Our guide was wonderful. And so much better to ride than to walk all over. The e bikes operated well and are easy to operate.
author: Robin_D

title: Top experience - personal and very knowledgeable guide
text: Great experience. I had booked a private tour so the tour was completely to what I wanted to see. Guide Zafan specializes in planning and urban development and you can see that. So much interesting info that really gets you to know the city. Highly recommended, especially for Dutch speakers
author: Rutger W
